# 7442 - 4-line-to-10-line decoder (1-of-10)

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7442.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7442.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 11 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7442 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7442.png) | ![7442 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7442.png) | ![7442 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7442.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A') | Output 0 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 2 | 1 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A) | Output 1 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 3 | 2 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A') | Output 2 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0010; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 4 | 3 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A) | Output 3 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0011; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 5 | 4 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A') | Output 4 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0100; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 6 | 5 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A) | Output 5 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0101; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 7 | 6 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A') | Output 6 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0110; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 9 | 7 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A) | Output 7 is low (active) only when DCBA = 0111; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 10 | 8 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A') | Output 8 is low (active) only when DCBA = 1000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 11 | 9 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A) | Output 9 is low (active) only when DCBA = 1001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | The SN7442A column of the recommended operating conditions prints IOH as '800' uA without the minus sign; the SN5442A column and the VOH test condition (IOH = -800 uA) show it is -800 uA out of the pin. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A,B,C,D | any | PHL | 14 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 2 levels of logic |
| A,B,C,D | any | PHL | 17 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 3 levels of logic |
| A,B,C,D | any | PLH | 10 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 2 levels of logic |
| A,B,C,D | any | PLH | 17 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, through 3 levels of logic |

## Notes

Datasheet does not say which output paths go through 2 and which through 3 levels of logic; timing gives both rows for all outputs. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-15, 7-16, 7-17 (PDF pages 14-16); SN7442A (the 1976 book lists only the A version of the plain 74 part)
